text: cool now that we clarified that the original problem needs the actual fix to it because its maddening
resolution: Ported the studio's concave Auto-Fix guard (req_0949) to the native mesh editor, replacing the invented differential heuristics that caused the maddening false 'Unsafe face edit' dialogs. mesh_edit.zig gains loopNewellNormal/loopIsConcave/newlyConcaveGroups — a verbatim port of editMesh.ts isFaceConcave/newConcaveFaces judging each authored face's chained boundary polygon (reuses chainGroupLoop from the loop-cut polygon work); only a face NEWLY buckled into a reflex corner fires. Rigid rotates, loop-cut slivers, hinge edits, and pre-degenerate meshes are silent by mathematical construction, not by tolerance exemptions. 3d.zig's meshGizmoFinish now calls the port; faceEdgeLensSq/faceMovedRigidly/collectUnsafeFaceEdits deleted. Dialog now speaks studio: 'Concave face / N face(s) buckled — not convex / Split Quads is recommended', counting authored faces not triangles. 4 new unit tests; zig build test-mesh-edit passes; SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 rjit ship editor compiles clean. Dev host needs its rebuild to pick up the framework change. Known non-parity left open: Split Quads still splits along the frozen diagonal (JS re-picks the convex one) — separate follow-up if wanted.
